intro: Iceland is a parliamentary republic with one of the oldest parliaments in the world and no army.

chapters.title: President and Althing
text: The president is elected directly for four years, and the Althing, with 63 members, chooses the government. Iceland has no army, but it is a founding member of NATO; its coast guard defends its waters.
Iceland is not in the EU but is part of the European Economic Area. National Day is 17 June.

chapters.title: Women leaders
text: Iceland elected the world's first woman president in 1980 and has had several female prime ministers. Halla Tómasdóttir became president in 2024.

keyTerms.meaning: A service that patrols a country's coastal waters.
